description: This file defines the syntax highlighting and language configuration for the 'freemarker2' language in the Monaco Editor, including tokenization rules, brackets, comments, and language-specific settings.

methods.name: p
methods.description: Configures language-specific brackets, comments, auto-closing pairs, and folding markers based on the provided configuration object.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Returns a language configuration object similar to 'p', with specific settings for brackets, comments, auto-closing pairs, and folding markers.
Constructs the language definition object, combining configurations and tokenizers for syntax highlighting.
